Independent delta review of 7f299c74f81332257eefd775086b355969ad85f3: PASS. No concrete blocker found in the new division/sqrt implementation. Reused accepted PR55/57/59/controller/AES/tail evidence; stacked base remains ce788d11285c901b52fd3cf0b450489d13b3f2f5.

FDIV_M operand/address handling, exact signed32 conversion and captured per-lane 0x00ffffffffffffff/exponent masks agree with unchanged native execution; FSQRT updates E[dst%4]. Rounding maps 0/2/3/1, DAZ/FTZ, signed zero, NaN payload/quieting, invalid/divzero and first-after-reset specials agree with the native SSE corpus. Normal work uses unchanged licensed HardFloat iterative arithmetic. Tagged pulse capture, held replies, unequal parallel completion, private shared-lane state and reset cancellation preserve atomic retirement. Both instructions leave integer lexical usage unchanged.

Goldens invoke native SSE or unchanged BytecodeMachine/iteration code; masks/results/targets are assertions only. Hardware receives raw ROM and actual addressed SRAM contents. Verified 13,312 full primitive records per configuration, the declared 2,560-case mapped corpus, 2,856 R/F/E/mode/PC retirements, 152 native denominator traces, 146 square roots and all 2 MiB. All 256 raw encodings are covered; the error path remains for impossible states without a physical-fault-tolerance claim.

The Icarus12 correction is sound: checksum-pinned original source is transformed in a separately labeled compile view by removing exactly one redundant scalar wire declaration already present as an ANSI output. All other bytes/notices and all twelve upstream originals match the retained release archive. Verified that Yosys commands continue to use the original vendor file. Hardware/oracle/stimulus inputs are unchanged; only the harness changed and the helper was added. The original 46-file hosted failure archive (45 digests) and indexed local failed-output/source archives remain preserved.

Independently verified 53 final source bindings, 128 hosted artifact digests, 21 matching fixture/view files and 23 matching PASS/cycle records: twelve RTL and eleven mapped modes. Actual shared/parallel units are 8,690/779 and 12,942/558 cells/flops; default top 274,346/10,504. Latency is operand-dependent; the controlled ideal/stalled fixture saves 17,228 clocks with parallel units. Shared whole-top mapping is absent.

All six final-head checks pass, including run 38387440257. Complete VM/hash, selected-core, physical memory and calibrated PPA remain open. Read-only review; no reproduction workload, implementation/artifact edit, base change or merge.
